questions.text: The feature lists six configuration areas (departments, packages, rate lists, staff, branding, operational settings). Should this single requirement cover all six, or only a subset (and which)? The rest would become separate requirements.
What are the 'operational settings' a Hospital Admin can configure (e.g. working hours, notification/SMS recipients, gate rules, EDD defaults)? Please list the fields.

Rate lists: the blueprint mentions 2 rate lists and 4 delivery categories with package caps. Should the Hospital Admin be able to create/edit both lists and the caps, and are edits versioned or effective-dated?
Staff: should this requirement include creating users and assigning roles (blueprint says Identity Service does not create users; Hospital Admin does), and which roles are assignable?
Branding: what is configurable (logo, name, colours, receipt header/footer) and are there file size/format limits?
Can configuration be edited before Super Admin ratifies the hospital's onboarding, or only once the tenant is active?
